notes: 54 cases = the 18 CEO-locked cells (grades 6-10 x {math, science}; grades 11-12 x {math, physics, chemistry, biology}) x 3 turn types (learn / explain / doubt). Schema + validator: eval/foxy-everyday/harness/case-schema.ts. Grades are P5 STRINGS. No PII of any kind: no names, no identifiers, no locations more specific than a generic Indian setting; the validator applies the same recursive PII-shaped-key ban as eval/rag/harness/golden-schema.ts. 8 cases target chapters measured to have ZERO active chunks in rag_content_chunks (corpus_state='zero_corpus'), because the directive changes GENERATION and must therefore work where retrieval returns nothing; every such claim cites the measurement. Every other case is corpus_state='unverified' -- the author of this fixture had no DB access and will not assert a corpus state it did not measure. v1 is English-only; a Hindi/Hinglish arm is a deliberate v2 gap (see README).
